_doc: Your Firebase web app's config (Firebase console → Project settings → Your apps → Web app); left empty, the game runs without a server. services says which parts of the project are up yet: set firestore to true once the Firestore database exists, and functions to true once the Cloud Functions are deployed (they need the Blaze plan). See firebase/README.md. appCheck: the reCAPTCHA Enterprise site key for App Check (public by design; enforce it in the Firebase console).
